To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

(i) commonsense knowledge can improve the search and retrieval process, (ii) commonsense knowledge is complementary to text, and (iii) commonsense knowledge improves the performance of search and retrieval when used in conjunction with text.

(1) the use of commonsense knowledge in the form of a commonsense knowledge graph can significantly improve search results; (2) the use of visual cues in the form of object/scene detection can also improve search results; and (3) the combination of both visual cues and commonsense knowledge can lead to further improvements in search results.
